criteria.text: User Action: User selects a specific chore from the chore list or chore history. Expected System Behavior: Displays the chore details, including chore name, assigned housemate, due date, completion status, and description.
User Action: User views a chore with no description. Expected System Behavior: The description area shows "No description added."
User Action: User selects "Back." Expected System Behavior: Returns to the previous screen.
criteria.note: Team decision (Anthony, 2026-11-19): Chore details has the shared header and tab bar like every household screen, so Back is the Chores tab, which returns to the chore list with its filter kept. README Conflicts row 33.

criteria.text: Error Condition: A chore has been deleted or is no longer available. Expected message: "Chore no longer available."
Error Condition: The chore details fail to load. Expected message: The system displays an error message and provides an option to retry loading the details.
